org.jwcarman.codec.crypto

Packages that use org.jwcarman.codec.crypto
Package
Description
org.jwcarman.codec.crypto
Envelope encryption as a Codec<byte[]> transform: AES-256-GCM over a per-message data key that is itself wrapped by a key-encryption key reached through the DataKeyProvider SPI (in-process JCE or a remote KMS).
  • Classes in org.jwcarman.codec.crypto used by org.jwcarman.codec.crypto
    Class
    Description
    DataKey
    A data-encryption key (DEK) acquired from a DataKeyProvider: the plaintext key material used to encrypt or decrypt one message, paired with the id of the key-encryption key (KEK) that wrapped it and the wrapped (ciphertext) form of the key itself.
    DataKeyProvider
    SPI for envelope-encryption key management, implemented by consumers against an in-process key store or a remote KMS (AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault, GCP Cloud KMS, etc.).
    DataKeyStrategy
    Pure lifecycle policy for acquiring the data-encryption key used to encode a message.
    DecryptionException
    Exception indicating that the data provided for decryption is invalid or corrupted.
    EnvelopeCodec
    Envelope-encryption Codec for byte[]: encrypts with AES-256-GCM under a per-message data-encryption key (DEK), itself wrapped by a DataKeyProvider and carried alongside the ciphertext.
    EnvelopeCodec.Builder
    Builder for EnvelopeCodec.
    JceDataKeyProvider
    In-process DataKeyProvider for consumers without a KMS, backed by one or more key-encryption keys (KEKs) supplied at construction.
    JceDataKeyProvider.Builder
    Builder for JceDataKeyProvider.
